import pandas as pd
import boto3

def run(date):
    s3 = boto3.client('s3')
    s3.download_file('metrics-bucket', f'daily/{date}.csv', '/tmp/in.csv')
    df = pd.read_csv('/tmp/in.csv')
    out = df.groupby('region').agg({'revenue': 'sum', 'users': 'sum'})
    out.to_parquet(f'/tmp/{date}.parquet')
